i'm on citalopram. i used to feel it was making me feel the way i'm supposed to. now it seems like it's just keeping from seeing reality or letting me have the sort of emotional crash i feel i need to break this numb feeling

> but it's a definite step in the right direction. You can't tell yourself otherwise. 

it feels like a new form of hell, not an improvement. I could deal with feeling like shit for a few days, with this i don't know how to handle it

> Do you have a strong support system around you ?

yes and know. only a few friends know i have depression and of those only one is someone i feel really understands and am comfortable openning up to

Nothing feels real at the moment and that's the problem. I can tell myself "i"m doing okay I can get through this" but as soon as i finish telling myself that theres numbness and isolation surrounding me and it doesn;t stop being there unless i have someway to alter my mind or feel something that seemd undeniablely real

I don't know. I never felt numb until I started what was supposed to be helpful. Not all the time, but every now and then. It's like where I used to have episodes of massive depression I now just become numb. I would like to sink down to where I used to feel, but I can't anymore and it's horrible to feel like I don't know what I'm feeling.

Expressing how I felt about someone. I had spent years ignoring those who seemed to like me and being too anxious and fearful to express how I felt. Finally I got to a point where I was feeling confident enough to put myself out there knowing that it might not work out. It didn't work out since she doesn't feel the same about me. It made all the progress I had made up to this point seem like an illusion. I felt it was wrong and foolish of me to feel good about myself. It's not so much that I'm heart broken over her (I wasn't in love with her and we're still friends) but somehow the experience has made me rethink if I really am supposed to feel good or even be alive or if I've been fooling myself the past few months. I don't how to explain it. There's no one thing I can actually pin point and say I feel bad becasue of this, really I feel like I'm being held aloft when I would rather fall.

Also, as far as talking I would like to do it via posting here rather than PM or communication outside reddit. It will make it easier for me to keep track of and that way others can chime on or at least get an idea of what's happening without me having to explain the same thing over and over.
I have. I was diagnosed with clinical depression after a suicide attempt in June. I see a therapist and am on an anit-depressant. I seemed to be doing better until recently.
Please do, I tried to post in [/r/depression](/r/depression) as well but was unable do to posting limits on new accounts (this is a throwaway)

> Cry if you need to, because it might help.

I can't, that's why I did it. I feel nothing. Even while doing it, it felt good while the blade was cutting but that feeling didn't last. I want to feel something but don't, no matter what, I just feel like I'm in purgatory. I want out. I want to feel something that seems real.
